title: 第7章 超速再生血幽第8章 出城
slug: 开局废了我开启最强进化
content_zh:
就以目前叶凌的情况来说，两百点灵力值，除了持续性消耗的灵视之外，其他两个灵技，最多就是有两次。
两次之后，灵力值就清空了，任何灵技都放不出来，只能等慢慢恢复。
而且随着等级提升，灵技需要消耗的能力值就越高。
就目前来看，叶凌所掌握的灵技，完全不需要进行升级。
因为升级之后，甚至有可能因为消耗太大反而用不了，确实没有太大的必要。
因此，现在叶凌手中的这两个自由点，叶凌决定全部给白眼僵尸加点。
点开了可以进行加点的天赋，以及可以进行加点的技能。
可加点天赋：
魔法伤害减免（低级）：小幅度减免魔法类别伤害
超速再生：只要不是被瞬间消灭，无论多么严重的伤势，都能过于极快的速度修复，需要消耗体力
可加点技能：
狂血：逐渐消耗自身血量，大幅度强化自身的力量和速度，然后血量降低到一定程度之后，会自动关闭。
有两个可加点天赋和一个可加点技能，看到这三个，叶凌几乎每一个都想要。
但是他现在手里面一共只有两个自由点，只能选择其中的两个。
“僵尸，就应该有僵尸的样子，没有超速再生怎么行？这个东西必须有。”
思索了一会儿后，叶凌毫不犹豫的选择了第一个加点，超速再生。
只要灵宠不死，各个部位都能够无限再生，简直无解。
要知道在联邦当中，有很多的御灵使，手中的灵宠，或多或少都有些伤残。
大部分都是在战斗的时候，受到了无法恢复的创伤，而导致的。
灵宠也是一种生物，会受伤，会死亡。

超速再生这种保命手段，必须点。
在第二个加点的时候，叶凌犹豫了片刻，最终选择了给技能加点，加在了技能狂血上。
之所以选择加点技能狂血，完全是为了配合另外一个技能嗜血。
使用狂血之后会逐渐减少自身的血量，从而提升力量和速度，到达一定值的时候就会自动关闭。
但此时血量会处于一个不健康状态，这时候再配合上技能嗜血，通过进攻敌人恢复自身的血量。
等到血量恢复满之后，又可以进行狂血。
如此循环往复，叶凌的女僵尸，说实话就有点恐怖了。
在狂血之下，力量和速度经过大幅度提升，女僵尸的战斗力可不仅仅只是现在的样子。
相比于是黑眼僵尸的时候，现在的女僵尸，实力简直强大的不要不要的。
同样，身体已经有了一定柔软度女僵尸，也不用一直像之前那样蹦蹦跳跳的。
content_en:
As far as Ye Ling's current situation is concerned, with two hundred points of spiritual power, in addition to the continuously consumed spiritual vision, the other two spiritual skills can only be used twice at most.
After two times, the spiritual power value will be cleared, and no spiritual skills can be released, and can only wait for recovery slowly.
And as the level increases, the higher the ability value that spiritual skills need to consume.
From the current point of view, Ye Ling's spiritual skills do not need to be upgraded at all.
Because after upgrading, it may even become unusable due to too much consumption. It is really not necessary.
Therefore, now that Ye Ling has these two free points in his hands, Ye Ling decides to give them all to the white-eyed zombies.
Click on the talents that can add points, and the skills that can add points.
Some talents can be added:
Magic damage reduction (low level): Small reduction in magic damage
Super-speed regeneration: As long as it is not wiped out instantly, no matter how serious the injury is, it can be repaired at an extremely fast speed, which requires stamina.
Skills that can be added:
Blood Frenzy: Gradually consume one's own blood volume, greatly strengthening one's own strength and speed. Then, after the blood volume drops to a certain level, it will automatically shut down.
There are two talents that can add points and one skill that can add points. Seeing these three, Ye Ling wants almost every one of them.
But now he only has two free points in his hand, and he can only choose two of them.
"Zombies should look like zombies. How can they do without super-speed regeneration? This thing must be there."
After thinking for a while, Ye Ling chose the first extra point without hesitation, super-speed regeneration.
As long as the spiritual pet does not die, all parts of it can be regenerated indefinitely, which is simply incomprehensible.
You must know that there are many spirit masters in the Federation, and the spirit pets in their hands are more or less disabled.
Most of them are caused by irrecoverable trauma during combat.
Spiritual pets are also living creatures that can be injured and die.
Overspeed regeneration, a life-saving method, must be used.
When adding points for the second time, Ye Ling hesitated for a moment, and finally chose to add points to the skill, and added it to the skill Crazy Blood.
The reason why I chose to add the skill Bloodlust is entirely to coordinate with the other skill Bloodthirst.
After using the crazy blood, it will gradually reduce its own blood volume, thus increasing its strength and speed. When it reaches a certain value, it will automatically turn off.
But at this time, the blood volume will be in an unhealthy state. At this time, combined with the skill bloodthirsty, you can restore your own blood volume by attacking the enemy.
After the blood volume is restored to full, you can start the blood craze again.
With this cycle repeating, Ye Ling's female zombie is a bit scary to be honest.
Under the crazy blood, the strength and speed have been greatly improved, and the female zombie's combat effectiveness is not just what it is now.
Compared to the time when they were black-eyed zombies, the current female zombies are simply too powerful.
Similarly, the female zombie's body already has a certain degree of softness, so she doesn't have to jump around like before.
